/blog/pcos-and-getting-pregnant/.Does PCOS increase miscarriage risk?: The risk is slightly higher, mainly when insulin resistance or other factors are also present. Good control of weight, sugar and thyroid before conception lowers it. Your doctor will explain what applies to you.

/blog/happens-after-embryo-transfer-symp.Is bed rest necessary after embryo trans: No. Studies show strict bed rest does not improve implantation and may even reduce blood flow. Normal daily activity is fine; avoid heavy lifting, intense workouts and heat on the abdomen for a few days.

/blog/pcos-fertility-ovulation-iui-ivf/.Which treatment is usually used first fo: Letrozole is the usual first choice for ovulation induction in PCOS, given for five days early in the cycle with follicular scan monitoring. If it does not work, the dose or medicine is changed.
/blog/pcos-fertility-ovulation-iui-ivf/.Is IUI useful for women with PCOS?: It can be, once ovulation is reliably triggered and at least one tube is open and the semen report is reasonable. IUI is usually considered after a few ovulation-induction cycles have not led to pregnancy.
/blog/pcos-fertility-ovulation-iui-ivf/.Can irregular periods mean I am not ovul: Often, yes. Periods that come very late or unpredictably usually reflect irregular or absent ovulation. A mid-luteal progesterone blood test or follicular scans can confirm whether you actually ovulate.
/blog/pcos-fertility-ovulation-iui-ivf/.Should my partner have a semen analysis: Yes. Male factors contribute to roughly a third of fertility problems, so testing both partners from the start saves months of treating the wrong problem. A semen analysis is quick and inexpensive.

/blog/blocked-fallopian-tubes-symptoms-h.Can you get pregnant with one blocked fa: Yes, many women conceive with one open tube, since either ovary can release the egg that month. The open tube must be healthy, which an HSG confirms. If it does not happen within the usual time, evaluation is the next step.
/blog/blocked-fallopian-tubes-symptoms-h.Is HSG painful?: Most women feel strong period-like cramps for a few minutes as the dye is pushed through. Taking a painkiller an hour before helps. Severe pain is uncommon, and the discomfort settles quickly once the test ends.
/blog/blocked-fallopian-tubes-symptoms-h.When is the best time to do an HSG?: It is done after your period ends and before ovulation, usually between cycle day 7 and 10, when there is no chance of an early pregnancy. Your clinic will tell you which day to book.
/blog/blocked-fallopian-tubes-symptoms-h.Can blocked tubes open on their own?: Sometimes mild spasm or a mucus plug clears, but true scarring or damage does not reverse on its own. If the blockage is real, options are tubal surgery in selected cases or IVF, which bypasses the tubes.
/blog/blocked-fallopian-tubes-symptoms-h.Is IVF the only option for blocked tubes: Not always. Younger women with limited damage near the tube end may be offered laparoscopic repair. IVF is preferred when damage is severe, both tubes are affected, or other fertility factors coexist.

/blog/female-infertility-tests-amh-ultra.What tests are done for female infertili: The standard set is AMH and other hormone blood tests, a pelvic ultrasound with antral follicle count, a tubal check such as HSG or HyCoSy, and a mid-luteal progesterone test. Your partner's semen analysis runs alongside.
/blog/female-infertility-tests-amh-ultra.What does a low AMH mean?: It means the ovary's egg reserve is smaller than average for your age. It does not mean you cannot conceive, because it says nothing about egg quality. It mainly guides how urgently to plan treatment.
/blog/female-infertility-tests-amh-ultra.Is the HSG test painful?: Most women feel brief period-like cramps while the dye passes through the tubes, settling within minutes. A painkiller beforehand helps. If a tube is blocked, pressure can build up and cause stronger but still short-lived pain.
/blog/female-infertility-tests-amh-ultra.When should I get fertility tests?: After 12 months of trying under 35, or after 6 months if you are 35 or older. Come sooner with very irregular periods, known tubal damage, severe period pain or a previous pelvic infection.
/blog/female-infertility-tests-amh-ultra.Does my partner need testing too?: Yes. Male factors play a role in around a third of couples, and a semen analysis is far simpler than the tests women undergo. Testing both partners together avoids months of one-sided investigation.

/blog/fibroids-and-fertility-can-you-get.Can fibroids cause infertility?: Only certain ones do. Fibroids that bulge into the uterine cavity (submucosal) or large ones that distort it can interfere with implantation. Fibroids in the outer wall usually do not affect fertility.
/blog/fibroids-and-fertility-can-you-get.Do I need to remove fibroids before IVF?: Not automatically. Removal is considered when the fibroid distorts the cavity, is large, or previous transfers failed. Small fibroids away from the lining are usually left alone and just monitored.
/blog/fibroids-and-fertility-can-you-get.How long after myomectomy can I try to c: Usually three to six months, depending on how deeply the fibroid sat in the wall. Your surgeon will advise based on the cavity and whether a caesarean-style entry was made into the uterus.
/blog/fibroids-and-fertility-can-you-get.Can fibroids cause miscarriage?: Cavity-distorting fibroids are linked to a higher miscarriage risk, which is one reason they may be removed before pregnancy. Fibroids that leave the lining untouched are not clearly tied to miscarriage.
/blog/fibroids-and-fertility-can-you-get.Do fibroids shrink on their own?: They can shrink after menopause when hormone levels fall, but during the reproductive years they tend to stay or slowly grow. Small fibroids are usually watched with periodic scans rather than treated.

/blog/unexplained-infertility-normal-tes.What does unexplained infertility mean?: It means standard tests show normal ovulation, open tubes, a normal uterus and a reasonable semen report, yet pregnancy has not happened. About a quarter of couples fall into this group.
/blog/unexplained-infertility-normal-tes.Can couples with unexplained infertility: Yes, a meaningful share conceive without treatment over the following one to two years, especially younger women. Whether to keep trying or move to treatment depends mainly on age and time already spent.
/blog/unexplained-infertility-normal-tes.Is IUI or IVF better for unexplained inf: IUI with ovulation medicine is often tried first because it is simpler and cheaper. If a few cycles do not work, or age and duration argue for faster results, IVF is the next step.
/blog/unexplained-infertility-normal-tes.What causes unexplained infertility?: The label hides subtler issues current tests miss: egg or sperm quality, fertilisation problems, mild endometriosis, or tubal transport problems. IVF itself sometimes reveals where the failure happens.
/blog/unexplained-infertility-normal-tes.Should we do more tests for unexplained: Often not, because routine testing already covers the main causes. Repeating tests rarely changes the plan. A specialist may add a laparoscopy or specific tests only when your history suggests something.

/blog/how-long-try-conceive-before-ferti.How long should we try before seeing a f: Twelve months of regular unprotected intercourse under 35, or six months at 35 and above. Come earlier with irregular periods, severe pain, known conditions or a history of pelvic infection.
/blog/how-long-try-conceive-before-ferti.Should we see a specialist sooner if per: Yes. Irregular periods usually mean irregular or absent ovulation, which testing can confirm quickly. There is little value waiting a full year when the problem is already visible and easily treated.
/blog/how-long-try-conceive-before-ferti.Does the male partner need testing?: Yes. A semen analysis is simple, cheap and answers a large part of the question. Male factors contribute to about a third of infertility, so testing him early prevents one-sided treatment.
/blog/how-long-try-conceive-before-ferti.Can we see a fertility specialist before: Yes. A preconception visit covers health checks, folic acid, medicines review, vaccination and conditions like thyroid or diabetes. It is sensible planning, not a sign that something is wrong.
/blog/how-long-try-conceive-before-ferti.How often should we have intercourse whe: Every two to three days through the cycle covers the fertile window without pressure. Timing only the ovulation day actually lowers the chances, because sperm live several days and the window is wider than one day.

/blog/low-amh-ovarian-reserve-fertility/.Is AMH the same as antral follicle count: No, but they measure the same thing differently. AMH is a blood test of the hormone small follicles release; AFC is a scan count of visible follicles. Together they estimate reserve better than either alone.
/blog/low-amh-ovarian-reserve-fertility/.Where can I get a low AMH fertility cons: At EVE Women and Fertility Clinic in Gunjur, East Bangalore, Dr. Swati Shree reviews AMH with your age, scan and history before any plan. Call 72049 21212 to book a consultation.

/blog/ovarian-hyperstimulation-syndrome-.What are the first signs of OHSS?: Bloating, abdominal discomfort, mild nausea and quick weight gain within days of the trigger injection or egg collection. Mild cases settle alone; worsening swelling, vomiting or breathlessness needs same-day review.
/blog/ovarian-hyperstimulation-syndrome-.How long does OHSS last?: Mild cases settle in about a week once the hormone levels fall. If pregnancy occurs, symptoms can linger a few weeks longer. Severe OHSS needing hospital care is uncommon with modern protocols.
/blog/ovarian-hyperstimulation-syndrome-.Can OHSS be prevented?: Risk can be lowered a lot: antagonist protocols, an agonist trigger, adjusted doses and freezing all embryos instead of a fresh transfer. Women with PCOS or many follicles benefit most from these steps.
/blog/ovarian-hyperstimulation-syndrome-.Does OHSS affect the chance of pregnancy: The OHSS episode itself does not reduce your chances, but a fresh transfer is usually postponed so the body recovers. The frozen embryo transfer that follows has outcomes as good as a fresh one.
/blog/ovarian-hyperstimulation-syndrome-.Should I go to hospital for bloating aft: Mild bloating is expected. Go the same day if you have severe or worsening pain, marked swelling, vomiting, very little urine, leg swelling or breathlessness. When in doubt, call your clinic first.

/blog/can-you-get-pregnant-naturally-low.Can I get pregnant with low AMH naturall: Yes. Low AMH means fewer eggs remain, not zero, and one egg is released each cycle. Age matters more than the AMH number itself, so acting sooner rather than waiting is the practical advice.
/blog/can-you-get-pregnant-naturally-low.Does low AMH mean poor egg quality?: No. AMH counts quantity, not quality. Egg quality depends mainly on age. A younger woman with low AMH often has good eggs; an older woman with normal AMH may not.
/blog/can-you-get-pregnant-naturally-low.What is considered a low AMH level?: Labs differ, but below about 1.0 ng/mL is generally called low, and under 0.5 very low. The number is always read against your age, since the same value means different things at 28 and 40.
/blog/can-you-get-pregnant-naturally-low.Can supplements increase AMH?: No supplement has been proven to raise AMH meaningfully or reverse reserve loss. Vitamin D and general health measures are reasonable, but be sceptical of products sold with promises of restored reserve.
/blog/can-you-get-pregnant-naturally-low.Should I freeze my eggs if my AMH is low: Worth discussing if you are under about 36 and not ready to conceive soon, because future reserve only shrinks. With very low AMH the yield per cycle may be small, so individual counselling matters.

/blog/low-amh-and-ivf-treatment/.Can IVF work with low AMH?: Yes, though fewer eggs are collected per cycle. The plan focuses on maximising each cycle: tailored doses, sometimes multiple cycles, and using every embryo well. Quality, not the count, decides the outcome.
/blog/low-amh-and-ivf-treatment/.How many eggs can I expect with low AMH?: It varies widely, often single digits to low double digits depending on the level and your response. Your doctor predicts from the AMH, antral follicle count and past cycles, then sets expectations honestly.
/blog/low-amh-and-ivf-treatment/.Does low AMH mean my IVF cycle will fail: No. Low AMH predicts fewer eggs, not failure. Pregnancy depends on getting at least one good embryo, and many low-AMH cycles succeed. Unrealistic promises either way should be treated with caution.
/blog/low-amh-and-ivf-treatment/.Should I do multiple IVF cycles with low: Sometimes it helps to bank embryos across two or three cycles before transferring, especially when reserve is very low. Your doctor weighs cost, time and response after seeing how the first cycle goes.
/blog/low-amh-and-ivf-treatment/.When are donor eggs considered?: When own-egg chances are very low despite reasonable attempts, or reserve is essentially exhausted. It is a personal decision made after honest counselling about odds, not something any doctor should push early.

/blog/amh-vs-egg-quality-difference/.Does AMH measure egg quality?: No. AMH reflects how many follicles remain, not how healthy the eggs inside them are. Age is the main marker of quality. A low AMH in a young woman is not the same problem as in an older one.
/blog/amh-vs-egg-quality-difference/.What determines egg quality?: Mainly age. Chromosome errors rise steadily through the 30s and sharply after 38, which is why age, not AMH, predicts embryo health. Smoking, severe illness and some conditions also play a role.
/blog/amh-vs-egg-quality-difference/.Can you have low AMH and good egg qualit: Yes, especially if you are younger. Low AMH narrows the number of eggs per cycle, not their health. It argues for acting sooner rather than assuming the eggs themselves are the problem.
/blog/amh-vs-egg-quality-difference/.Is there a test for egg quality?: No blood or scan test reads egg quality directly. Age is the best guide, and embryo development during IVF shows it indirectly. Marketing claims of quality tests should be treated carefully.
/blog/amh-vs-egg-quality-difference/.Can I improve my egg quality?: You cannot reverse age-related change, but stopping smoking, limiting alcohol, treating thyroid problems and good metabolic health help the environment eggs mature in. Supplements have limited, unproven benefit.

/blog/low-amh-at-30-35-40-age/.What does low AMH mean at age 30?: It means reserve is smaller than typical for your age, but egg quality is usually still good. The practical advice is to start trying sooner or discuss egg freezing rather than assuming infertility.
/blog/low-amh-at-30-35-40-age/.Is low AMH at 35 a concern?: It deserves prompt attention because both quantity and quality decline from here. It is still very possible to conceive; the point is not to lose time. Evaluation of both partners should start now.
/blog/low-amh-at-30-35-40-age/.Can I get pregnant at 40 with low AMH?: It is possible but harder, since age affects quality as well as quantity. Options include prompt IVF, banking embryos or, honestly discussed, donor eggs. A specialist should map realistic odds for you.
/blog/low-amh-at-30-35-40-age/.Does AMH decrease every year?: Broadly yes, it declines with age, though the fall varies between women and occasional readings fluctuate. One value matters less than the trend and the whole picture, including your scan.
/blog/low-amh-at-30-35-40-age/.Should I freeze my eggs if I have low AM: It is a reasonable option if pregnancy is some years away, since eggs frozen now are younger than any you would produce later. Discuss expected yield with your specialist before deciding.

/blog/can-endometriosis-cause-infertilit.Can I get pregnant naturally with endome: Many women do, especially with mild disease. The chance depends on how severe it is, whether the tubes and ovaries are affected, your age and egg reserve. A specialist can stage the likely impact.
/blog/can-endometriosis-cause-infertilit.Does endometriosis affect egg quality?: The evidence is mixed. Severe disease and ovarian cysts can lower reserve and may affect the environment eggs mature in, but many women with endometriosis produce good embryos. Individual assessment matters more than the label.
/blog/can-endometriosis-cause-infertilit.Does surgery for endometriosis improve f: Sometimes, mainly for moderate to severe disease or painful symptoms, where removing lesions can restore anatomy. Surgery on ovarian cysts can also reduce reserve, so it is weighed carefully before operating.
/blog/can-endometriosis-cause-infertilit.How is endometriosis diagnosed?: Ultrasound can pick up endometriotic cysts and deep disease, and MRI adds detail. Mild endometriosis is only proven by laparoscopy, which is not always needed to start treatment.
/blog/can-endometriosis-cause-infertilit.Is IVF needed for endometriosis?: Not always. Mild disease with open tubes and good reserve may be tried naturally or with IUI first. IVF is advised when tubes are damaged, reserve is low, age is a factor or simpler steps have failed.
/blog/can-endometriosis-cause-infertilit.Should I see a specialist if I have pain: Yes. Severe period pain plus difficulty conceiving is a classic reason to look for endometriosis. Early review finds treatable causes and avoids months of waiting while the disease progresses.

/blog/endometriosis-symptoms-not-to-igno.Is severe period pain always endometrios: No, but pain that stops normal life is not something to simply endure. Adenomyosis, fibroids and other causes look similar. A gynaecology review with a scan is the way to find out which it is.
/blog/endometriosis-symptoms-not-to-igno.Can endometriosis be seen on ultrasound?: Endometriotic cysts and deep nodules often can be, especially on a good transvaginal scan. Superficial deposits are invisible on scans and are found only at laparoscopy or suspected from symptoms.
/blog/endometriosis-symptoms-not-to-igno.At what age does endometriosis start?: It can begin in the teenage years and is most often diagnosed between 25 and 40. Symptoms may be present for years before the diagnosis, which is why persistent severe period pain deserves review.
/blog/endometriosis-symptoms-not-to-igno.Can endometriosis cause pain outside per: Yes. Some women have pain through the month, pain with intercourse, pain passing urine or opening bowels, or lower back pain. Cyclical worsening around periods is a typical clue.
/blog/endometriosis-symptoms-not-to-igno.Does endometriosis run in families?: It can. Having a mother or sister with endometriosis raises your risk several-fold, though most women with the condition have no family history. Genes are one factor among several.
/blog/endometriosis-symptoms-not-to-igno.Can endometriosis go away after pregnanc: Pregnancy often quiets symptoms for a while, but endometriosis does not reliably disappear and frequently returns after periods restart. It is not a cure, despite the common advice.

/blog/adenomyosis-and-fertility-symptoms.Can you get pregnant with adenomyosis?: Many women do, though severe disease can make implantation harder. Treatment may calm the inflammation first, and options range from natural attempts to IVF depending on severity and age.
/blog/adenomyosis-and-fertility-symptoms.What is the difference between adenomyos: In adenomyosis, lining-like tissue grows inside the womb muscle itself; in endometriosis it sits outside the uterus. Both cause pain and heavy periods and often coexist, but they are different conditions.
/blog/adenomyosis-and-fertility-symptoms.How is adenomyosis diagnosed?: Transvaginal ultrasound showing an enlarged, uneven womb muscle usually suggests it, and MRI confirms the extent. Unlike endometriosis, it rarely needs surgery just for diagnosis.
/blog/adenomyosis-and-fertility-symptoms.Can adenomyosis be treated before IVF?: Yes. A few months of hormone suppression can calm the uterus before embryo transfer in selected cases. Your specialist decides based on severity, because suppression is not right for everyone.
/blog/adenomyosis-and-fertility-symptoms.Does adenomyosis go away after menopause: Usually it settles, since it is driven by the same hormones that stop at menopause. Until then it is managed with pain relief, hormonal treatment or, in selected cases, surgery.

/blog/pregnant-with-endometriosis-withou.Can mild endometriosis stop pregnancy?: It can contribute, mainly by inflammation around the tubes and eggs, but mild disease often slows rather than prevents conception. Many women with mild endometriosis conceive without IVF.
/blog/pregnant-with-endometriosis-withou.Does IUI work for endometriosis?: It can help in mild disease with open tubes, good reserve and a reasonable semen report. For moderate or severe disease, or once simpler steps have failed, IVF is usually more effective.
/blog/pregnant-with-endometriosis-withou.Should I have surgery before trying to c: Only in selected cases, such as significant disease affecting anatomy or severe pain. Surgery on the ovaries can reduce egg reserve, so it is weighed against the expected fertility benefit.
/blog/pregnant-with-endometriosis-withou.Can I take hormone tablets for pain whil: Most hormonal treatments for endometriosis stop ovulation, so they cannot be used while trying. Pain relief compatible with conception exists; your doctor will choose what is safe at each stage.
/blog/pregnant-with-endometriosis-withou.Does endometriosis come back after pregn: Often, yes. Pregnancy may ease symptoms temporarily but is not a cure. If it was part of why conception took time, planning the next pregnancy sooner is usually wise.

/blog/endometriosis-and-ivf/.Is IVF successful with endometriosis?: Yes, outcomes are reasonable, though severe disease can lower response and embryo numbers. Protocols are adjusted for the inflammation and reduced reserve that sometimes come with the condition.
/blog/endometriosis-and-ivf/.Should I remove endometriosis cysts befo: Not routinely. Cyst surgery can cost you egg reserve, so it is reserved for large cysts, suspicion of something other than endometriosis, or easy access problems at egg collection.
/blog/endometriosis-and-ivf/.Does endometriosis affect embryo quality: Evidence is mixed. Severe disease and ovarian cysts may affect the eggs' environment, but many women with endometriosis make good embryos. Reserve and age are better guides than the label.
/blog/endometriosis-and-ivf/.Can endometriosis get worse during IVF?: Stimulation can temporarily aggravate symptoms, and ovarian cysts can grow a little, but IVF does not typically drive the disease forward. Your team watches for this during the cycle.
/blog/endometriosis-and-ivf/.Is frozen embryo transfer better for end: Often preferred, because it lets the hormones settle first and sometimes follows a period of suppression that calms the uterus. Your specialist will recommend it when the uterus needs quietening.
/blog/endometriosis-and-ivf/.How soon should I move to IVF with endom: Sooner if disease is moderate to severe, tubes are damaged, reserve is low or you are over 35. With mild disease and time on your side, a short trial of simpler options may come first.

/blog/ovulation-tracking-how-to-know-fer.When is the best time to get pregnant in: The five days before ovulation and the day of it, because sperm survive several days but the egg lives only about a day. Regular intercourse every two to three days covers it without pressure.
/blog/ovulation-tracking-how-to-know-fer.How accurate are ovulation kits?: Good at detecting the LH surge that precedes ovulation by about a day, but they can mislead in PCOS where LH runs high anyway. They confirm a surge, not that an egg was actually released.
/blog/ovulation-tracking-how-to-know-fer.Can I get pregnant if my cycle is irregu: Yes, though the fertile window is harder to predict, so signs like cervical mucus or follicular scans help more than calendar counting. Investigating why cycles are irregular often reveals a fixable cause.
/blog/ovulation-tracking-how-to-know-fer.What is follicular monitoring?: A series of transvaginal scans across one cycle that watch the follicle grow and confirm it releases an egg. It tells you the actual fertile days and is used to time intercourse or IUI.
/blog/ovulation-tracking-how-to-know-fer.Does basal body temperature predict ovul: It confirms ovulation only after it has happened, since temperature rises once progesterone appears. Useful as a record over months, but not for timing this cycle's fertile days on its own.

/blog/iui-vs-ivf-which-fertility-treatme.What is the main difference between IUI: The difference also drives everything else: cost, intensity, medicines and who each treatment suits. Your diagnosis and how long you have been trying decide which starting point makes sense for you.
/blog/iui-vs-ivf-which-fertility-treatme.Is IUI or IVF more successful?: Per cycle IVF gives higher rates, which is why older women or those with tubal or severe sperm issues are advised it earlier. For suitable couples, a few IUI cycles first is a reasonable plan.
/blog/iui-vs-ivf-which-fertility-treatme.Can I have IUI if my tubes are blocked?: No, at least one tube must be open for the egg and sperm to meet. With both tubes blocked, IVF is the effective route; with one open and healthy tube, IUI may still be tried.
/blog/iui-vs-ivf-which-fertility-treatme.Should I try IUI before IVF?: If you are younger with mild male factor, ovulation problems or unexplained infertility, a few IUI cycles first is reasonable. Severe tubal or sperm disease points straight to IVF instead.
/blog/iui-vs-ivf-which-fertility-treatme.Is IUI painful?: It feels much like a Pap smear: a thin catheter passes through the cervix in under a minute, with mild cramping possible for a few hours after. No anaesthesia or recovery time is needed.

/blog/how-many-iui-cycles-before-ivf/.How many IUI cycles should I try?: Commonly three to four, since most IUI pregnancies happen in the first few cycles. If it has not worked by then, more cycles rarely change the odds and moving to IVF is usually wiser.
/blog/how-many-iui-cycles-before-ivf/.Is it worth trying more than four IUI cy: Usually not, because success drops sharply after the first three to four attempts. Exceptions exist for specific situations, but in general continuing adds cost and delay without improving the odds much.
/blog/how-many-iui-cycles-before-ivf/.Should women over 35 try IUI?: A short trial may be reasonable if tests look good, but time matters more after 35. Many specialists suggest fewer IUI cycles, or going to IVF sooner, so the best years are not lost.
/blog/how-many-iui-cycles-before-ivf/.Why did my IUI fail?: A failed cycle usually reflects the monthly chance, not something done wrong. Repeated failures may point to factors IUI cannot overcome, like egg quality or mild sperm issues, and argue for reassessment.
/blog/how-many-iui-cycles-before-ivf/.When should we go directly to IVF?: When both tubes are blocked, sperm counts are very low, egg reserve is poor, the woman is older, or infertility has run for years. In those cases IUI adds little and IVF is the effective route.

/blog/what-to-do-after-iui-precautions-s.Can I go to work after IUI?: Yes, normal activity including work is fine the same day. Avoid very strenuous exercise, heavy lifting and heat on the abdomen for a couple of days, but there is no need for bed rest.
/blog/what-to-do-after-iui-precautions-s.Is spotting after IUI normal?: Light spotting for a day or two is common and usually comes from the catheter touching the cervix. Heavy bleeding, severe pain or fever is not typical and deserves a call to the clinic.
/blog/what-to-do-after-iui-precautions-s.When can I have intercourse after IUI?: Intercourse on the same day or the next is usually fine and may even be advised unless your doctor says otherwise. It does not disturb the sperm already placed in the uterus.
/blog/what-to-do-after-iui-precautions-s.How soon can I take a pregnancy test aft: Wait about 14 days after the procedure. Testing earlier risks a false negative, or a false positive if a trigger injection was used. A blood test at the clinic is the reliable check.
/blog/what-to-do-after-iui-precautions-s.What symptoms mean I should call the doc: Severe or worsening pelvic pain, fever, heavy bleeding, or marked bloating and vomiting if ovulation medicines were used, since that can signal ovarian hyperstimulation. Mild cramps and spotting are expected.

/blog/iui-success-factors/.What is the best age for IUI?: Younger women do better, with the strongest results under about 35. Rates decline with age, which is why older women are often advised fewer IUI cycles before moving to IVF.
/blog/iui-success-factors/.Does sperm count matter for IUI?: Yes. The prepared sample needs enough moving sperm; severe male factor lowers IUI success considerably, and IVF with ICSI is usually advised instead once counts are very poor.
/blog/iui-success-factors/.Do both tubes need to be open for IUI?: At least one must be open and healthy, since fertilisation still happens inside the tube. An HSG or HyCoSy confirms this before starting; both blocked tubes mean IVF is the route.
/blog/iui-success-factors/.Does ovulation medicine improve IUI outc: For women with ovulation problems or unexplained infertility, mild stimulation improves the odds by ensuring one or two mature follicles. It is monitored to avoid too many follicles and twins.
/blog/iui-success-factors/.Can lifestyle changes improve IUI succes: To a degree: not smoking, sensible weight, low alcohol and folic acid help the odds. They support the cycle but cannot overcome blocked tubes, severe sperm problems or the effect of age.
/blog/iui-success-factors/.Can stress affect IUI results?: Everyday stress does not appear to change outcomes measurably, though it makes the process harder to live through. Practical support and realistic expectations help more than chasing perfect calm.

/blog/male-infertility-causes-symptoms/.Can a man look healthy and still be infe: Yes, most men with fertility problems have no symptoms at all. Normal health, erections and libido say nothing about sperm count or quality, which is why a semen analysis is the only way to know.
/blog/male-infertility-causes-symptoms/.What lifestyle habits reduce male fertil: Smoking, heavy alcohol, anabolic steroids, recreational drugs, obesity and regular heat exposure such as saunas or laptops on the lap. Reversing them helps, though sperm take about three months to renew.
/blog/male-infertility-causes-symptoms/.Does age affect male fertility?: Yes, though far more gradually than in women. Counts and motility decline with age and DNA damage rises, which is why very low values or repeated failures deserve a proper urology review.
/blog/male-infertility-causes-symptoms/.Can male infertility be treated?: Often, yes, depending on the cause: infections, hormones, varicocele, lifestyle and some blockages are treatable. When direct treatment falls short, ICSI with IVF can work with very few sperm.
/blog/male-infertility-causes-symptoms/.Should men be tested before women start: Yes, and it should happen at the same time as the woman's evaluation. A semen analysis is cheap and painless, and skipping it can mean months of treating the woman for a problem that is his.
/blog/male-infertility-causes-symptoms/.Can stress affect sperm?: Severe prolonged stress may affect hormones and indirectly sperm, but it is a smaller factor than smoking, heat or illness. Worrying about stress itself is counterproductive during a workup.

/blog/semen-analysis-explained/.What is a normal sperm count?: WHO reference values are about 16 million per mL concentration and 39 million per ejaculate, with motility and shape also counted. One slightly low value matters less than the trend across two tests.
/blog/semen-analysis-explained/.Can I collect a semen sample at home?: Often yes, if the lab allows it and the sample reaches them within about an hour kept at body temperature. Many clinics prefer on-site collection so conditions and timing are controlled.
/blog/semen-analysis-explained/.Is low morphology a serious problem?: Not always. Strict scoring makes even normal samples show low normal-shape percentages, and many men with low morphology still father children. It matters most read with count and motility.
/blog/semen-analysis-explained/.How long does a semen analysis take?: The appointment itself is short, and results usually come within a few days. Two to seven days of abstinence before the test gives a sample that reflects your usual production.
/blog/semen-analysis-explained/.What should I do if my semen analysis is: Repeat it after several weeks, since single results fluctuate with illness, fever and abstinence. A persistently abnormal result leads to a physical exam, hormone tests or a urology review.

/blog/low-sperm-count-treatment-options/.How long does it take to improve sperm c: About three months minimum, since sperm take roughly 74 days to develop. Lifestyle change or treatment started today shows in a semen report after two to three months, not sooner.
/blog/low-sperm-count-treatment-options/.Can diet improve sperm count?: A balanced diet with vegetables, protein, zinc-rich foods and less processed fat supports production, but no single food or supplement reverses a genuinely low count. Weight and smoking matter more.
/blog/low-sperm-count-treatment-options/.Does testosterone help low sperm count?: Counterintuitively, no. Outside testosterone suppresses the brain signals that drive sperm production and can drop the count further. Never self-medicate; hormone issues need specific, supervised treatment.
/blog/low-sperm-count-treatment-options/.Can a varicocele be the cause of low spe: Yes, enlarged scrotal veins are a common, treatable cause. Repair is considered when the varicocele is significant and the semen report is poor, but not every small varicocele needs surgery.
/blog/low-sperm-count-treatment-options/.Can a man with very low sperm count beco: Very often, yes. ICSI needs only a few viable sperm injected into each egg during IVF, so even severe counts can lead to biological children. The first step is confirming the level on repeat testing.
/blog/low-sperm-count-treatment-options/.Are fertility supplements for men effect: Evidence for supplements like zinc, selenium and CoQ10 is modest at best; they may help borderline results but will not fix a genuinely low count. Treat the cause first, and see supplements as optional extras.

/blog/icsi-male-infertility/.Is ICSI the same as IVF?: ICSI is a step inside an IVF cycle, not a different treatment. Standard IVF lets sperm and egg meet in a dish; ICSI injects one chosen sperm directly into each egg, mainly for male factor.
/blog/icsi-male-infertility/.Does ICSI improve pregnancy chances?: When sperm is the problem, yes, it markedly improves fertilisation. For couples without male factor it adds little, so clinics reserve it for the cases where it genuinely helps.
/blog/icsi-male-infertility/.Is ICSI painful for the woman?: The process is identical to IVF for her: injections, monitoring and egg collection under sedation. ICSI happens entirely in the lab afterward, so she feels no difference at all.
/blog/icsi-male-infertility/.Can ICSI be used with surgically retriev: Yes, and that is one of its main uses. Sperm from TESA or PESA are too few and too immature for standard IVF, so injecting them directly into the egg is how such samples are used.
/blog/icsi-male-infertility/.Are babies born through ICSI healthy?: Large studies show outcomes broadly similar to standard IVF, with a small debated increase in certain anomalies linked more to the infertility itself than the technique. Your doctor will discuss this openly.
/blog/icsi-male-infertility/.Will ICSI fix poor sperm DNA quality?: Not necessarily. ICSI gets the sperm into the egg but cannot repair DNA fragmentation. High fragmentation may need lifestyle change, treatment of causes, or testicular sperm in selected cases.

/blog/why-both-partners-need-fertility-e.Why should the man be tested if the woma: Because two problems can coexist, and hers being found does not make his impossible. Male factors sit in about a third of couples, so skipping his test risks solving only half the problem.
/blog/why-both-partners-need-fertility-e.Is male infertility common?: Yes, it contributes to roughly a third of cases and is the sole cause in a good share of them. It is common enough that a semen analysis belongs in the first round of every evaluation.
/blog/why-both-partners-need-fertility-e.What is the first test for men?: A semen analysis after two to seven days of abstinence. It reports count, movement and shape in one cheap, quick test, and abnormal results lead to an exam and possibly hormone blood tests.
/blog/why-both-partners-need-fertility-e.Can both partners be tested on the same: Yes, and that is how it should work. The woman's blood tests and scan can be planned by cycle day while the man gives a semen sample, so most of the workup finishes inside one cycle.
/blog/why-both-partners-need-fertility-e.What if both partners have normal tests?: That is called unexplained infertility, about a quarter of couples. Options range from a few IUI cycles to IVF depending on age and how long you have been trying, and a specialist will lay them out.
/blog/why-both-partners-need-fertility-e.How can couples support each other throu: Attend appointments together, share results as a team rather than as blame, and keep the process in perspective. A single semen sample or blood draw is a small step, not a verdict on either person.

/blog/positive-pregnancy-test-after-ivf-.Why is hCG repeated after a positive tes: One value confirms pregnancy; the rise between two tests a few days apart shows whether it is developing as expected. A slow or falling level prompts earlier scanning to check the pregnancy is in the right place.
/blog/positive-pregnancy-test-after-ivf-.When will I have my first scan after IVF: Usually around six to seven weeks of pregnancy, when the scan can confirm the sac is inside the uterus and ideally show a heartbeat. Your clinic schedules it once the hCG trend looks right.
/blog/positive-pregnancy-test-after-ivf-.Is spotting normal in early IVF pregnanc: Light spotting is common, especially with progesterone support and a sensitive cervix, and is often harmless. Heavy bleeding, pain or one-sided pain needs a same-day call, since ectopic risk matters after IVF.
/blog/positive-pregnancy-test-after-ivf-.How long do I need progesterone after IV: Commonly until about ten to twelve weeks, when the placenta takes over hormone production. Your clinic gives a clear stopping plan, so do not stop early even if everything feels fine.
/blog/positive-pregnancy-test-after-ivf-.Is an IVF pregnancy high risk?: Not automatically. Most IVF pregnancies progress normally, though early monitoring is closer and some factors like age or twins add risk. After the first trimester it is managed much like any pregnancy.
/blog/positive-pregnancy-test-after-ivf-.When can I share the news?: Whenever you feel ready, though many couples wait for the first heartbeat scan or the end of the first trimester when miscarriage risk falls. There is no medical rule about timing.

/blog/embryo-implantation-after-ivf-time.How soon does implantation happen after: Usually within one to three days after a day-5 transfer, once the embryo hatches and embeds in the lining. The blood test about nine to twelve days later is the reliable way to know it worked.
/blog/embryo-implantation-after-ivf-time.Is implantation bleeding common after IV: Light spotting around the expected period can happen but is not reliable evidence either way, and many successful cycles have none. Only the blood test gives a real answer.
/blog/embryo-implantation-after-ivf-time.Can I feel the embryo implanting?: Almost never. Mild cramps or twinges in the two-week wait are common and mean nothing either way, since progesterone causes similar sensations. Symptoms are a poor guide; the test is the answer.
/blog/embryo-implantation-after-ivf-time.When should I take a pregnancy test afte: On the day your clinic advises, usually nine to twelve days after a day-5 transfer. Testing early risks a false negative, or a false positive if a trigger injection is still clearing.
/blog/embryo-implantation-after-ivf-time.Does bed rest help implantation?: No. Studies show bed rest does not improve implantation and may even be unhelpful. Gentle normal activity is fine; just avoid heavy lifting, intense workouts and heat on the abdomen for a few days.
/blog/embryo-implantation-after-ivf-time.Can stress stop implantation?: Ordinary stress has not been shown to block implantation, though the two-week wait is genuinely hard. Simple routines, gentle activity and avoiding hour-by-hour symptom checking help more than chasing calm.

/blog/blastocyst-transfer-embryo-grading.What does embryo grade 4AA mean?: The number is expansion stage and the letters grade the inner cell mass and trophectoderm, with A best. A 4AA is a well-expanded, high-quality embryo, though grading predicts potential, not a guaranteed outcome.
/blog/blastocyst-transfer-embryo-grading.Can a low-grade embryo result in a healt: Yes. Grading is a prediction tool, not a verdict, and lower-grade embryos do produce healthy babies. Doctors transfer the best available, but a lower grade does not mean the cycle is lost.
/blog/blastocyst-transfer-embryo-grading.Is day 5 transfer better than day 3 tran: For most patients, yes, because embryos that reach day 5 have proven stronger development and single blastocyst transfer reduces twins. Day 3 may be chosen when few embryos are growing.
/blog/blastocyst-transfer-embryo-grading.Why do some embryos stop growing before: Most arrest because of chromosome errors that prevent further development, which is exactly what the culture period reveals. It is disappointing but means the lab selected the embryos with the best chance.

/blog/frozen-embryo-transfer-process-pre.Is frozen embryo transfer better than fr: For many patients outcomes are equal or slightly better, because the lining can be prepared calmly without stimulation hormones. Freezing also lets a transfer wait when OHSS risk or timing argues for it.
/blog/frozen-embryo-transfer-process-pre.How long can embryos stay frozen?: Many years. Survival on thawing is excellent with modern vitrification, and healthy babies are born from embryos frozen for over a decade. Storage has annual consent and paperwork requirements.
/blog/frozen-embryo-transfer-process-pre.Is frozen embryo transfer painful?: No. It is a quick procedure like a Pap smear, placing the thawed embryo through a thin catheter without sedation. Most women feel nothing beyond mild discomfort and return to normal activity.
/blog/frozen-embryo-transfer-process-pre.When should I take a pregnancy test afte: On the date your clinic sets, usually nine to twelve days after a day-5 embryo transfer. Testing sooner risks false negatives and, if a trigger was used, a misleading positive.
/blog/frozen-embryo-transfer-process-pre.Can I resume normal activities after emb: Yes, normal daily activity is fine and bed rest is not needed. Avoid very strenuous exercise, heavy lifting and heat on the abdomen for a few days while the embryo settles.

/blog/early-pregnancy-after-ivf-warning-.Is bleeding in early IVF pregnancy alway: No. Light spotting is common and often harmless, though any bleeding after IVF deserves a call the same day. Heavy bleeding with strong pain is the pattern that needs urgent assessment.
/blog/early-pregnancy-after-ivf-warning-.Can ectopic pregnancy happen after IVF?: Yes, slightly more often than after natural conception, which is why early scanning to confirm the sac is inside the uterus is routine. One-sided pain with bleeding is the warning pattern.
/blog/early-pregnancy-after-ivf-warning-.What is OHSS in early pregnancy?: Ovarian hyperstimulation can persist or worsen if pregnancy occurs, with marked bloating, rapid weight gain, vomiting or breathlessness. Report these promptly, since moderate or severe OHSS needs hospital care.
/blog/early-pregnancy-after-ivf-warning-.Are cramps normal after a positive IVF t: Mild cramps are common and usually harmless, helped along by progesterone support and the stretching uterus. Severe, worsening or one-sided pain with or without bleeding needs prompt review.
/blog/early-pregnancy-after-ivf-warning-.Should I go to the emergency room or cal: Call the clinic first during the day, since they know your cycle and can triage quickly. For severe pain, heavy bleeding, faintness or breathlessness, go to emergency care without waiting.
/blog/early-pregnancy-after-ivf-warning-.Can I travel during early IVF pregnancy?: Short, uneventful travel is usually fine after the pregnancy is confirmed well placed on scan. Keep medicines, reports and your clinic's number handy, and avoid long trips before the first scan.

/blog/recurrent-miscarriage-recurrent-pr.How many miscarriages before testing is: Evaluation is generally offered after two consecutive losses, and after three is standard. With a strong history or older age, earlier review is reasonable. Your doctor will tailor when to begin.
/blog/recurrent-miscarriage-recurrent-pr.Is recurrent miscarriage caused by somet: No. Most early losses come from chromosome errors in that embryo, not from work, exercise, travel or anything you ate or did. The evaluation looks for the few treatable causes.
/blog/recurrent-miscarriage-recurrent-pr.Can I have a healthy pregnancy after rec: Yes, most couples do. Even after several losses, a good share of next pregnancies succeed, especially once treatable causes are found. Early supportive monitoring in the next pregnancy helps.
/blog/recurrent-miscarriage-recurrent-pr.Do men need to be tested after recurrent: Yes. A semen analysis and sometimes DNA fragmentation are checked, since sperm factors contribute to embryo quality. Both partners' chromosome testing is part of the standard workup.
/blog/recurrent-miscarriage-recurrent-pr.Does age affect the risk of miscarriage?: Yes, clearly. Chromosome errors rise with egg age, so risk climbs through the late 30s and 40s. Age also shapes which tests and treatments offer the best value for you.
/blog/recurrent-miscarriage-recurrent-pr.Should I try again soon after a miscarri: Physically, most women can try after one normal cycle once they feel ready emotionally. There is no medical need to wait many months, though recurrent loss deserves its evaluation first.

/blog/hysteroscopy-for-infertility-when-.Is hysteroscopy painful?: It is usually done under sedation or short anaesthesia, so you feel nothing during it. Mild cramping and spotting for a day or two afterward is common and settles quickly.
/blog/hysteroscopy-for-infertility-when-.Does hysteroscopy improve fertility?: When it finds and removes a problem such as a polyp, small fibroid, septum or scar tissue, yes. As a routine step with a normal cavity it adds little, which is why it is used selectively.
/blog/hysteroscopy-for-infertility-when-.When can I try to conceive after hystero: Often after one normal period, though removing a septum or larger lesion may need a few months for the lining to heal. Your surgeon gives a clear timeframe for your procedure.
/blog/hysteroscopy-for-infertility-when-.Do I need hysteroscopy before IVF?: Not routinely. It is advised when scans suggest a polyp, fibroid, septum or scarring, or after repeated failed transfers with good embryos. A normal cavity does not need routine scoping.
/blog/hysteroscopy-for-infertility-when-.What are the risks of hysteroscopy?: It is generally safe; uncommon risks include infection, bleeding, or rarely a small hole in the uterine wall. These are uncommon, and your specialist explains them before the procedure.

/blog/tests-after-recurrent-miscarriage/.Do I need every test after recurrent mis: No. The standard set covers the uterus, parental chromosomes, antiphospholipid antibodies and thyroid; extras like extensive immune panels are added only when your history suggests them.
/blog/tests-after-recurrent-miscarriage/.What is antiphospholipid syndrome?: An immune condition where certain antibodies raise clotting risk and are linked to recurrent miscarriage. It is found on blood tests and treated in the next pregnancy with aspirin and heparin.
/blog/tests-after-recurrent-miscarriage/.Why test the uterus after miscarriage?: To look for structural problems that can disturb implantation or growth, such as a septum, polyps, fibroids or scar tissue. Ultrasound, saline sonography or hysteroscopy shows them clearly.
/blog/tests-after-recurrent-miscarriage/.What is a parental karyotype?: A blood test that maps the chromosomes of each partner to find balanced rearrangements. A carrier is healthy but can make embryos with unbalanced chromosome sets, which is one cause of repeated loss.
/blog/tests-after-recurrent-miscarriage/.Can thyroid problems cause miscarriage?: Untreated thyroid disease and thyroid antibodies are linked to higher miscarriage risk, which is why TSH is part of the workup. Treating a genuinely abnormal result improves the outlook.
/blog/tests-after-recurrent-miscarriage/.Should pregnancy tissue be tested after: When available, chromosome testing of the tissue can show whether the loss was a random embryo error, which guides whether deeper testing of the couple is useful. Your doctor will advise when it helps.

/blog/thyroid-problems-and-fertility/.Can hypothyroidism prevent pregnancy?: Untreated hypothyroidism can disturb ovulation and raise miscarriage risk, but treated well it rarely stops conception. A TSH blood test is a routine part of every fertility evaluation.
/blog/thyroid-problems-and-fertility/.What TSH level is best for pregnancy?: Most specialists aim for roughly under 2.5 mIU/L before and during early pregnancy, since needs rise once you conceive. Your dose is adjusted and rechecked through each trimester.
/blog/thyroid-problems-and-fertility/.Should I take thyroid medicine during pr: Yes, keep taking it; the need usually increases in pregnancy and stopping is the greater risk. Levothyroxine is safe, and doses are monitored with regular TSH tests.
/blog/thyroid-problems-and-fertility/.Can thyroid antibodies cause miscarriage: Antibodies alone are linked to a somewhat higher miscarriage risk even with normal TSH, though evidence is mixed. Your doctor may lower the treatment threshold or monitor more closely when they are present.
/blog/thyroid-problems-and-fertility/.Do both partners need thyroid tests?: Usually just the woman, since thyroid effects on fertility act through ovulation and pregnancy. His history may prompt a check if symptoms or results suggest it, but routine testing is hers.

/blog/genetic-testing-in-ivf-pgt-a-is-it.What is PGT-A in IVF?: A biopsy of a few cells from a day-5 embryo, tested to count its chromosomes before transfer. It aims to avoid transferring embryos with the wrong number, a major cause of failure and miscarriage.
/blog/genetic-testing-in-ivf-pgt-a-is-it.Does PGT-A improve IVF success?: It helps selected groups, mainly older women and those with repeated failures or losses, by avoiding transfers destined to fail. For younger women with few embryos the benefit is debated.
/blog/genetic-testing-in-ivf-pgt-a-is-it.Is embryo biopsy safe?: Generally yes in experienced labs; the biopsy takes a few outer cells that would form the placenta, not the part that becomes the baby. A small risk of harming the embryo exists and is weighed.
/blog/genetic-testing-in-ivf-pgt-a-is-it.What is the difference between PGT-A and: PGT-A screens chromosome numbers for common errors. PGT-M tests for a specific inherited disease the couple carries, and needs a custom probe built for that family's mutation first.
/blog/genetic-testing-in-ivf-pgt-a-is-it.Do I still need prenatal tests after PGT: Yes. PGT is a screening tool, not a guarantee, so standard prenatal screening and, when advised, diagnostic tests like amniocentesis are still recommended during the pregnancy.

/blog/fertility-after-35-when-to-seek-he.Is it harder to get pregnant after 35?: Yes, gradually rather than suddenly. Egg quantity and quality decline, so it often takes longer, but many women conceive in their late 30s. Time matters more, which is why the six-month rule exists.
/blog/fertility-after-35-when-to-seek-he.Why should I see a specialist after 6 mo: Because each month has a smaller chance and waiting a full year loses time that matters at this age. A basic evaluation quickly shows whether anything needs correcting before more trying.
/blog/fertility-after-35-when-to-seek-he.Does a normal AMH mean my fertility is f: Not by itself. AMH counts eggs, not their quality, which declines with age regardless. A normal AMH at 38 is reassuring but does not reset the clock on quality or time.
/blog/fertility-after-35-when-to-seek-he.Does miscarriage risk increase after 35?: Yes, because chromosome errors rise with egg age. It climbs gradually through the late 30s and more steeply after 40, which is part of why acting sooner is advised rather than waiting.
/blog/fertility-after-35-when-to-seek-he.Should I consider IVF straight away afte: Not automatically. If tests look good, a timed natural or IUI trial may come first; IVF is favoured when time, reserve or diagnosis argues for faster results. The plan follows the workup.
/blog/fertility-after-35-when-to-seek-he.Can lifestyle changes improve fertility: They support the odds but cannot reverse age. Stopping smoking, limiting alcohol, healthy weight and folic acid help, but the biggest lever after 35 is simply not losing more time.

/blog/egg-quality-after-35/.Can I improve my egg quality after 35?: You cannot reverse age-related change, but stopping smoking, treating thyroid or metabolic problems and good general health support the environment eggs mature in. Supplements have limited, unproven benefit.
/blog/egg-quality-after-35/.Is there a test for egg quality?: No test reads egg quality directly. Age is the best guide, and embryo development during IVF shows it indirectly. Be cautious of products or tests that claim to measure it.
/blog/egg-quality-after-35/.Do supplements like CoQ10 improve egg qu: Evidence is limited and inconsistent. CoQ10 is generally safe and some clinics suggest it, but it cannot undo the effect of age. Spend effort on what is proven before supplements.
/blog/egg-quality-after-35/.Does good AMH mean good egg quality?: Not necessarily. AMH counts how many follicles remain, not how healthy the eggs are. A woman of 40 can have a normal AMH and still poorer quality than a woman of 28 with low AMH.
/blog/egg-quality-after-35/.Can diet improve egg quality?: A balanced diet supports overall reproductive health, but no diet has been shown to reverse age-related egg change. What helps most is acting promptly rather than searching for a perfect regimen.
/blog/egg-quality-after-35/.Should I freeze my eggs to protect egg q: Freezing preserves the age the eggs are now, so it is most useful if done earlier rather than later. At 35-plus it is worth an honest discussion about realistic numbers and chances.

/blog/pregnancy-after-40-fertility-risks.Can I get pregnant naturally after 40?: Yes, though the monthly chance is much lower and miscarriage risk higher. If you want to try, do so promptly with preconception checks in place rather than a long unmonitored wait.
/blog/pregnancy-after-40-fertility-risks.Is pregnancy after 40 safe?: Usually, with closer monitoring. Risks of diabetes, blood pressure problems, chromosome conditions and complications rise with age, which is why early antenatal care and screening matter more.
/blog/pregnancy-after-40-fertility-risks.Is IVF effective after 40?: It can be, though success per cycle falls with egg age. Options like PGT-A, embryo banking or, discussed honestly, donor eggs come into the picture depending on reserve and priorities.
/blog/pregnancy-after-40-fertility-risks.What is PGT-A and should I consider it?: A chromosome screen of embryos before transfer, which is more relevant after 40 because a larger share of embryos carry errors. Whether it helps depends on how many embryos you get.
/blog/pregnancy-after-40-fertility-risks.When are donor eggs considered?: When own-egg chances are very low despite reasonable attempts, or reserve is essentially gone. They offer high success and are a personal decision made after honest counselling, never pushed early.
/blog/pregnancy-after-40-fertility-risks.What tests should I have before trying a: AMH, an antral follicle scan, TSH and general health checks for you, plus a semen analysis for your partner. These quickly show whether prompt treatment or a monitored natural trial fits.

/blog/egg-freezing-fertility-preservatio.What is the best age to freeze eggs?: Earlier is better, ideally in the early to mid 30s when more eggs are frozen and they are healthier. Freezing later still works but typically needs more cycles for the same chance.
/blog/egg-freezing-fertility-preservatio.How many eggs should I freeze?: Commonly ten to twenty mature eggs gives a reasonable chance of one future pregnancy, depending on age at freezing. Some women need more than one cycle, which your specialist estimates upfront.
/blog/egg-freezing-fertility-preservatio.Is egg freezing painful?: The process mirrors the first half of IVF: hormone injections, scans and egg collection under sedation. Injections sting a little; the collection itself is not felt. Recovery is a day or two.
/blog/egg-freezing-fertility-preservatio.How long can eggs stay frozen?: Many years. Survival rates on thawing are high with modern vitrification. Indian law and clinic policy set storage and consent rules, which your clinic explains when you freeze.
/blog/egg-freezing-fertility-preservatio.Does egg freezing affect my future ferti: No. It uses eggs that would have been lost that month anyway, so it does not reduce your reserve or your chances of conceiving naturally later. Most women conceive without ever using them.
/blog/egg-freezing-fertility-preservatio.Can I freeze embryos instead of eggs?: If you have a partner, embryos survive freezing even better than eggs and give clearer odds later. The choice depends on your situation, since embryos carry shared consent considerations.

/blog/ivf-after-35-when-to-consider/.Should I go straight to IVF at 35?: Not automatically. If tests look good, a short trial of natural attempts or IUI may come first; IVF is favoured when time, reserve or the diagnosis argues for faster results. The workup decides.
/blog/ivf-after-35-when-to-consider/.How many IUI cycles should I try after 3: Fewer than a younger woman might, since time matters more. Many specialists suggest two to three at most before reassessing, or skipping IUI entirely when reserve or sperm factors argue for IVF.
/blog/ivf-after-35-when-to-consider/.Is IVF more successful than IUI after 35: Per cycle, yes, which is exactly why it is favoured when time is short. The trade-off is greater cost and intensity, so the decision weighs your age, diagnosis and how long you have tried.
/blog/ivf-after-35-when-to-consider/.Does low AMH mean I need IVF immediately: Not always, but it argues against a long unmonitored wait. If reserve is low at 35-plus, evaluation should be prompt and IVF often enters the plan sooner than it would for a younger woman.
/blog/ivf-after-35-when-to-consider/.Can I freeze embryos during IVF for late: Yes, spare good embryos are routinely frozen for a later transfer or a sibling. Freezing adds flexibility, and outcomes with modern vitrification are as good as fresh transfer.
/blog/ivf-after-35-when-to-consider/.Is genetic testing of embryos needed aft: Not required, but more relevant, since a larger share of embryos carry chromosome errors. Whether PGT-A helps depends on how many embryos you produce and your history.
